profile_text: With a strong presence in Düsseldorf, Germany, this gastronomy company is driving growth in the food and beverage industry, leveraging its expertise to expand its operations and increase its workforce. With 45 employees in 2024, the company is well-positioned to continue its upward trajectory, capitalizing on emerging trends and opportunities in the accommodation and food service sector.
